text:
Priya: Heads-up: launching a small pilot for route-level usage carryforward + per-route burst smoothing. This is aimed at customers who buy reserved capacity but see uneven per-route usage and large invoice swings.
Priya: Key points: 1) Unused reserved minutes on a route can be carried forward for up to 72h and consumed by that route (not across routes). 2) Per-route burst smoothing buffers short microbursts by applying a soft-aggregation window (30s) before billing ticks. 3) Pilot is opt-in for reserved customers; not enabled for hosted-meter customers.
Marco: Clarification: this affects invoicing aggregation only — no change to runtime per-second rate enforcement. If a route exceeds runtime limits we'll still throttle.
Dan: Implementation note: we'll add a per-route metadata field `route_carryforward=true` and a carryforward ledger entry type `CF_72H`. Carryforward consumption will be visible in `invoices.line_items` as separate rows.
Nina: Support/Docs: prepare an FAQ: how carryforward looks on invoices, how to opt-in/out, and examples. I'll draft.
Finance: Need to confirm GL mapping for `CF_72H` items and whether they count as contra-revenue or adjustments. Also tax implications per region.
Legal: Quick review requested  include a short pilot clause: "Carryforward credits are subject to the pilot's terms and may be modified."
Priya: Pilot details: start with 30 customers tomorrow (2026-04-02 03:00 UTC), expand to 200 next week if metrics stable. GA in ~4 weeks pending results.
Marco: Deploy plan: billing-service `deploy/billing/2026-04-02/route-carry-v1`. Migration will populate per-route ledgers for the last 7 days for opt-ins. Expect low DB CPU spike.
Billing-bot: INFO: scheduled deploy at 2026-04-02T03:00:00Z (2758133600).
Dan: Monitoring: add metrics `billing.route_carryforward_used`, `billing.route_smooth_backfill_errors`, alert if carryforward consumption > 60% of reserved capacity for any single route (risk of unexpected spend).
Support: We'll also add canned messages for customers who see additional invoice line items. Create a playbook for escalations to Finance for tax questions.
Finance: Also request CSV sample of invoices with new line items for accounting teams.
Priya: Opt-out: customers can request `route_carryforward=false` via account settings or support ticket within 48h of opt-in.
Marco: Note: carryforward is route-scoped. If customers require cross-route pooling, that's a separate product discussion.
Nina: Draft FAQ link: https://docs.redwood/support/route-carryforward.md (WIP).
Priya: Action items: Eng  finalize migration script and DB knobs (Marco/Dan). Finance  GL mapping & sample invoices (Finance). Legal  finalize pilot clause (Legal). Support  FAQ + playbook (Nina). PM  targeted email to pilot customers (Priya).
Finance: We'll aim to provide GL mapping by EOD tomorrow.
Marco: Will post deploy notice in #eng-oncall 1 hour before.
Support: Preparing escalation contact list.
Priya: We'll monitor early invoices for anomalies and share a summary after 48h. Thanks team :memo:
